_comment: Playwright MCP for this project (feature/playwright-mcp track). Headless + programmatic email/password login (config/.env); storageState replay is unreliable, so --storage-state is intentionally omitted (see known-quirks.md 2026-06-22). Jira fetch uses a separate, interactively-authenticated Atlassian MCP that may be absent in headless `claude -p` runs — pre-fetch test cases into testcases/english/ during an interactive session, or wire a remote Atlassian MCP server here. See MIGRATION.md.
